label: ivr
scenario: After-hours recorded greeting that is effectively voicemail: long message, tone, caller leaves a message, system confirms it was sent. Nothing accomplished.
task: Get a price quote for replacing the customer's gas water heater.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Hi, you've reached Copperline Plumbing and Drain. Our office hours are Monday through Friday, seven AM to five PM. If this is a plumbing emergency, such as a burst pipe or a sewer backup, please press 1 to reach our on-call technician. Otherwise, please leave your name, number, and a brief description of the job after the tone, and we'll return your call the next business day.

turns.speaker: bot
turns.text: Hi, this is an AI assistant calling on behalf of a customer, Gavin Mercer, at 229 Linwood Avenue. He'd like a quote to replace a forty-gallon gas water heater. Please call him back at 555-0147. Thank you.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Your message has been recorded. To listen to your message, press 1. To erase and re-record, press 2. To send your message, press 3, or simply hang up.
